title: The Ra Contact - Volume 2
author: Unknown
description: The Ra Contact: Teaching the Law of One, Volume 2 (L/L Research, 2018), completing the definitive re-edited transcription of the 106 sessions held with the source calling itself Ra through Carla L. Rueckert, with Don Elkins as questioner and Jim McCarty as scribe (relistening project by Tobey Wheelock; production and editing by Gary Bean and Austin Bridges). This volume covers the later sessions, where the questioning grows more technical and intimate: the archetypical mind and the 22 images of the tarot as its concept complexes, the veil of forgetting, catalyst and experience, the energy centres and the balancing of the self, psychic greeting and negative entities, polarity and harvest, and the conditions of the contact itself, which ended with Elkins's death in 1984. Together with Volume 1, it forms the authoritative text of the Law of One material.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection.
rights: From the curator's private collection. Publication rights for this edition are to be confirmed before public release.
